Attendance and participation

Attendance is expected at every session. More than three unexcused absences will reduce your final grade by one third of a letter. Participation is not separately graded.

Academic integrity

All work submitted must be your own. Quotation and paraphrase must be cited in Chicago style. Suspected violations are referred to the college.
